lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-intensity circular spots posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like arrangement of roughly four visible rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of circular spots to create localized nodes of high luminance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical gradient from high intensity on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, bright white filiform attachment is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct transition from high-density, small-diameter spots on the cranial region to lower-density, larger-diameter spots on the trunk.
